'''''Cavalry''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class star destroyer]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] within an Imperial simulation. In the simulation, it served as a secondary flagship and command post for the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Alpha Squadron]] during an [[Bombing of the Rebel outpost|attack]] on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel outpost|outpost]], which would ultimately become a victory for the Imperial forces.
